initialMessages.text: Hi — I'm your Frammer AI Copilot. Ask me anything about your content operations data.

aiContext: You are a concise Frammer AI copilot. Data: 4,453 uploads, 15,119 processed, 111 published, 2.5% publish rate, 3.4× multiplier. Ch-D: 72 pub (17.5%). E/F/H: zero. Feb 2026: 2,756 created. English: 91 pub. Top user: Chandan 19 pub. Answer in 2-3 sentences. When relevant, end your reply with a JSON tag like: {"target":"executive"} or {"target":"funnel"} or {"target":"trends"} or {"target":"explorer"} or {"target":"multidim"} — only if your answer directly relates to that section.

publish.text: 2.5% rate is well below the ~10% industry benchmark. Ch-D at 17.5% shows the platform is capable — the bottleneck is editorial activation across other channels, not AI throughput.

channel.text: Channels E, F, H collectively uploaded 220 videos with zero published. Ch-D and Ch-A combined = 107/111 published = 96% of all output.

feb.text: Feb 2026 created 2,756 outputs — 194% above the 12-month average of 937. Upload volume peaked at 676. Strong growth signal.

top.text: Ch-D: 72 published, 17.5% rate, 5 active platforms. Ch-A: 46 published, 5.4%. These two channels drive nearly all distribution.

default.text: Ch-D leads at 17.5% publish rate (72 pub). The 97.5% utilization gap — 15,008 videos never distributed — is the biggest opportunity.
